environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function processes file uploads via SQS messages. The S3 bucket 'upload-bucket-prod' has public read access enabled via bucket policy for a CDN. No file validation is performed. Any internet caller can POST to the Function URL without authentication, queue arbitrary upload payloads, and upload malicious files (including HTML with XSS payloads) that are publicly readable via the S3 bucket's public endpoint.
